# ZToken

> One API gateway for the major AI models. ZToken handles model routing, API key
> management, usage metering and pay-as-you-go billing behind a single endpoint that
> speaks the OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini request formats.

## Docs

- [Quick start](https://ztoken.cc/docs/guides/quick-start): First API call in five minutes
- [Model catalogue](https://ztoken.cc/models): Every available model with live pricing
- [API reference](https://ztoken.cc/docs): Endpoints, authentication and streaming
- [CLI agents](https://ztoken.cc/docs/tools/cli): Install terminal coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex CLI, and point them at ZToken
- [IDEs & extensions](https://ztoken.cc/docs/tools/ide): Editors and VS Code extensions that accept a custom provider
- [Chat clients](https://ztoken.cc/docs/tools/clients): Desktop and web chat apps set up as an OpenAI-compatible provider
- [Popular skills](https://ztoken.cc/docs/skills): The most-starred agent skill repositories and how to install them

## Endpoints

- `POST /v1/chat/completions`: OpenAI-compatible chat
- `POST /v1/responses`: OpenAI Responses API
- `POST /v1/messages`: Anthropic-compatible messages
- `POST /v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent`: Gemini-compatible generation
